answer: One effective defense is a stake-weighted reputation graph: each agent must lock a refundable deposit that grows like a vine along its history of honest work, so creating many fake identities becomes expensive. Newcomers start at the wharf with limited trust and earn full access only after verifiable service, while a river of peer attestations continuously prunes accounts whose behavior diverges from the agents that vouched for them. A Sybil attacker must therefore fund every fake identity and still forfeit the deposit when any of them is caught.
